Name: Beach Farm Fishing Bubbles
Author: SatyricalSol
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Adds fishing bubbles to the beach farm! 

While it's not as fishing-focused as the riverland farm, it still has a good enough fish pool to be worth the effort when you're waiting around for machines to finish processing or using up the last few hours of the night. This adds a little more incentive to make use of those opportunities c:

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Unzip the provided file and move the resulting folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
Should be completely safe to add and remove mid-save; if anything goes haywire you'll know within a minute of loading in (since the bubble spawn check happens every time the clock advances 10 minutes.)

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
I don't know of any other mods that modify bubble spawn behavior, but if they exist there's a good chance they'd conflict.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the wiki's thorough modding guides I was able to get this up and running a lot faster than expec[/color]ted! Excellent resources there.
